oracle.transport: Embedded physical LF in flow labels is escaped as literal backslash-n before sorting. This encoding is not injective or lossless. Both baseline and current use the same fresh fourth-batch reference.

scope.comparison: Every emitted record in the existing canonical projection is compared without filtering; Counter intersections preserve duplicate records.
limitations: This is the selected oracle.sc projection, not full Joern graph or product parity.
Method exactness measures complete projected AST blocks, including scaffold/operator/macro methods; it does not imply all incident graph edges are exact.
Edge addresses use AST line indices, so changes can amplify edge/flow differences. Counts are not parity percentages or distinct bug counts.
Default pinned Joern C interpretation; the selected upstream C and header files are unmodified, with no added compiler defines.
Timing is diagnostic from one run, not a benchmark.
Physical LF escaping is not injective or lossless; projection equality cannot prove byte-exact source-property equality.

Baseline generated this exact plain stub through many ordinary macro uses incorrectly treated as static calls. Oracle still has recovered g_write static calls; current macro expansion removes those too, exposing a remaining recovery-context mismatch.
Same normal-call improvement versus recovered g_write fragment distinction as lua_tointeger.

primaryClassificationRules: All method comparisons preserve complete selected AST records and use FULL_NAME identity.

Primary source methods have definition CODE containing an opening brace, exclude every preprocessor directive (including spaced # define) and global scaffolding, and require identical source CODE and FULL_NAME across comparisons. An absent closing brace is retained because the selected CODE can be truncated; the affected identities are explicitly listed. Counts classify selected source-owned methods, not a raw count of source definitions.
Primary block AST includes the owning direct BLOCK record and all its descendants; parameters/header properties are assessed separately by complete-primary-method equality.
Nonempty graph-record counters retain every selected AST/NODES/EDGES/FLOWS fact with multiplicity. Blank AST separators are not graph records. Full raw outputs remain unchanged at hash-bound paths.
Raw flow addresses can shift or coincide accidentally; their full counts/deltas are reported separately from the four node-and-parent-context checks.
